# Ceylon JOJO Travels

> Private Sri Lanka tours with local chauffeur drivers, custom itineraries, and holiday packages.

Ceylon JOJO Travels is a family run Sri Lanka tour operator based in Kalutara. We offer private day tours and multi day round tours with hotel stays and private transportation. Guests book in English, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Polish, or Russian.

## Who we are

- Brand: CEYLON JOJO TRAVElS
- Base: Kalutara, Western Province, Sri Lanka
- Contact: ceylonjojotravels@gmail.com | WhatsApp +44 7375 612946
- TripAdvisor: https://www.tripadvisor.com/Attraction_Review-g304136-d34039344-Reviews-Ceylon_JoJo_Travels-Kalutara_Western_Province.html
